```{r}
m_headers <- read_csv("/Users/jdumanski24/Desktop/CDSC/Levine/McGannData.csv", n_max = 2, col_names = F, show_col_types = F)

questions <- as.character(m_headers[1,])

answer_choices <- as.character(m_headers[2,])

questions_filled <- na.locf(ifelse(questions == "" | is.na(questions), NA, questions))

clean_headers <- paste(questions_filled, answer_choices, sep = "_")

m_rawdata <- read_csv("/Users/jdumanski24/Desktop/CDSC/Levine/McGannData.csv", skip = 2, col_names = clean_headers, show_col_types = FALSE)

m_non_coalesced <- m_rawdata %>%
  select(c(10:ncol(m_rawdata)))

m_non_coalesced <- m_non_coalesced %>%
  mutate(
    across(
      everything(),
      ~ na_if(as.character(.), "")
    )
  )

m_questions <- m_non_coalesced %>%
  mutate(Q1 = do.call(coalesce, pick(1:6))) %>%
  mutate(Q2 = do.call(coalesce, pick(7:12))) %>%
  mutate(Q3 = do.call(coalesce, pick(13:21))) %>%

m_no_sata <- m_questions %>%
  select(184:204, 111:122, 205:213, 162:183)

m_coalesced <- m_no_sata %>%
  mutate(Q11a = pmap_chr(select(., 22:27), ~ paste(na.omit(c(...)), collapse = "; "))) %>%
  mutate(Q11b = pmap_chr(select(., 28:33), ~ paste(na.omit(c(...)), collapse = "; "))) %>%
```
